newsitem.title: UK: Austin Reed shares gain after trade update.
newsitem.headline: Austin Reed shares gain after trade update.

text.p: Shares in clothing retailer Austin Reed Group Plc rose on Tuesday after the company said sales were up ten percent for the period up to Christmas.
In a trading update the company said margins had improved over the same period, particularly in womenswear. The winter sales period had also gone according to plan and better margins were achieved.
Meanwhile, the group's wholesale business in mainland Europe had continued to disappoint due to the lack of consumer confidence in these markets, Austin Reed said.
